home.headline: I bring research, visual design, and development together.
home.introduction: Hi there. I’m Carl, and I’m eager to apply for the Senior Design Lead role at Work & Co. I bring more than 15 years of experience taking digital projects from early questions through design and implementation. Your emphasis on making products together, with designers staying involved in the details, is what draws me to this opportunity.
home.projectsIntroduction: I’ve tailored the following case studies to highlight the work and outcomes most relevant to your team: shaping product direction, developing the visual and interactive details, and working with clients and developers through delivery.
